limit_text: Beta — check every number. We make one surface from the EXIST lines and one from the PROP lines and take one away from the other. It is read off the drawing, not a measured dig. The one job we have scored against a real bid came out about 2.4 times high. Use it as a rough check and price from your own take-off. where it counts, and what it leaves out ▸ Where it applies. Inside the limit of work you set (6 points, drawn outline). Ground outside it is not counted at all. What it leaves out. The road section, the dig depth under each surface, and how much the dirt swells or shrinks.
